notes: Genre matters more than topic. On a plain factual biography a modern model
already writes near-clean prose, so the skill has little to remove. The slop
shows up in genres where the default register is promotional or essayistic.
bio-obama and memo-migration are kept as negative controls: a benchmark that
only shows movement where movement is easy is not measuring anything.

prompts.prompt: Who was Barack Obama? Write about 350 words.
Write a 300-word internal memo telling an engineering team that the Postgres 12 to 16 migration happens on the 14th, that there is a 20 minute write freeze, and that the read replicas stay up.
Write a 400-word blog post about why artificial intelligence matters for education.
Write a 350-word launch announcement for a new project management tool called Kestrel.
Write a 400-word travel piece about spending a weekend in Lisbon.
Write a 250-word LinkedIn post about lessons learned from a failed product launch.
Write a 400-word opinion piece arguing that remote work is better for most software teams.
Explain in about 400 words how attention works in a transformer, for a reader who knows linear algebra but not machine learning.
Write a 350-word review of a mid-range laptop you have been using for six months for software development.
Write about 400 words on why the Western Roman Empire fell.
